messages:
sarah: Quick heads-up — planning to onboard `equinox-2.7b` into the model-catalog tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need a pin, a short canary (5% traffic), and smoke + rollback owners. Who can take smoke and own rollback readiness? :spiral_calendar_pad:

leo: I can own the smoke run. Will validate latency, token counts, and end-to-end API responses. Can do the 10:00 slot. What infra slot are we using?

sarah: thanks leo. using dedicated slot `catalog-canary-a` (GPU pool alpha). Should be available — @infra confirmed reserve.

sandeep: I'll own rollback. Can prepare the rollback alias and a playbook. Quick checklist I'll follow:
- pin alias `equinox:stable -> equinox-2.7b` with canary percent config
- prepare `equinox:prev` alias snapshot
- smoke suite runbook (leo) -> pass/fail criteria

maria: pinging devex to make sure docs + changelog entry go out after pin. Also need CI check on quantized artifact path.

devex-bot: @maria noted. Please attach the changelog PR link here once ready. Template: `docs/catalog/CHANGELOG.md` entry + example request/response.

sarah: leo — for smoke, please run these quick checks:
1) 20 short generations, assert p95 generation latency < 600ms on canary slot
2) 50 prompt range (short/med/long) for correctness sanity (sanity prompts in `/eng-ml/smoke/prompts/equinox.txt`)
3) embedding vector dims check (if enabled)

leo: got it. I'll run smoke at 10:05 PT (5 min warmup). Will post summary as a snippet. If anything flaky, I'll tag @sandeep and revert the pin.

sandeep: I'll prepare the rollback alias now. Quick command I'll run if needed:```bash
redwood-cli catalog alias set equinox:stable --target equinox:prev
redwood-cli deploy rollback --model equinox-2.7b --reason "smoke-failed"
```

leo: small note — quantized artifact path differs for this model: `s3://redwood-models/equinox/2.7b/quant-v2/` — include that in CI smoke.

maria: I'll open the changelog PR after the pin completes. tagging docs-owners for visibility.

sarah: timeline recap: 10:00 reserve, 10:05 smoke, 10:20 canary open (5% traffic), monitor 30m -> full pin if stable. If rollback, target 10:25 window to minimize overlap.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job queued: `catalog-pin equinox-2.7b` slot=catalog-canary-a run_at=1765432800

leo: smoke done — quick summary:
- p95 latency (20 runs): 520ms
- 50 prompts sanity: 0 low-quality flags, one minor hallucination on a long prompt (investigating)
- embedding dims: 1536 OK

leo: tagging output: ```
PASS: latency, embeddings
WARN: one hallucination on prompt #37 (long, >2k tokens)
```

sandeep: good catch. I'll stand by with rollback prepared. If you mark FAIL, I'll flip alias. Otherwise let's proceed to canary.

sarah: proceeding to open canary at 10:20. @leo + @sandeep monitor metrics (latency, error-rate, quality signals). I'll trigger the changelog PR after 30m.

maria: noted — I'll update the onboarding checklist with the quant path and the hallucination note.

leo: watching infra metrics now. No errors. p99 tailing slightly up but within SLO.

sandeep: rollback ready command prepped and tested in staging. Will only execute on explicit fail.

sarah: thanks all. If canary stays clean, we'll promote after the 30m window. Otherwise escalate here and we roll back. :white_check_mark:
